hard-engage.text: Hard engage: stay behind your wave or in a bush until they commit, then answer with Terrify / Reap instead of trying to out-range them.

spell-shield.text: Spell shield can eat your first Terrify or Reap: bait it with the lesser spell, then follow up with the real one and Crowstorm.

cleanse.text: They can cleanse: don't rely on a single Terrify to win a fight; chain Reap's silence right after it.

untargetable.text: Untargetable / stasis wastes Crowstorm: wait for the effect to end before you channel.

high-mobility.text: Mobile champion: Crowstorm channels are easy to leave; use Terrify first to pin them in place, then channel.

point-click-cc.text: Targeted CC interrupts your channels: don't start Bountiful Harvest or Crowstorm while their CC is up.

burst.text: Burst threat: don't stand in front of them; ambush from a bush and keep your Flash for your own Crowstorm.

ranged-poke.text: Poke lane: stay behind minions, sit in a bush to look like a scarecrow, and heal back with Bountiful Harvest on minions.

lane-bully.text: Strong early laner: play safe under tower until level 6, then threaten with Crowstorm.

gank-setup.text: Gank setup: ward your flank; Crowstorm and Terrify are good tools to peel when their jungler arrives.

anti-engage.text: Anti-engage: wait until their disengage is down before you flash into Crowstorm.

invisibility.text: Invisible threat: carry a Control Ward and ward your own bush so your scarecrow trick is not turned against you.

aoe-cc.text: Area CC: spread from your carry and don't channel in the middle of their combo.

early-game.text: Early-game champion: concede the first trades and look for a level-6 Crowstorm flash.

powerSpikes.note: Full engage kit: Zenith Blade plus Shield of Daybreak is lethal with her carry.
Solar Flare is a big AoE lockdown on top of her engage.

dangerAbilities.name: Zenith Blade
dangerAbilities.note: Dash and root: dodge it sideways or sit behind minions.

dangerAbilities.name: Solar Flare
dangerAbilities.note: AoE stun interrupts your channels; don't start Crowstorm while it is up.

tips.text: Stay behind your minions in the bush: if Zenith Blade hits a minion she cannot reach you.
Terrify her when she commits, then Reap to stop her from casting.
Don't channel Bountiful Harvest while she can engage.
Level 6 Crowstorm after she uses her engage is your counter-engage.

itemAdjustments.name: Mercury's Treads
itemAdjustments.note: Tenacity cuts her stun and root.

runeAdjustments.note: Helps you survive early poke while you wait for level 6.

Leona.reviewNotes: Draft written from champion kits, not match data; verify against your own games.

powerSpikes.note: Hook plus Depth Charge makes his lane dangerous.
Depth Charge is a point-and-click lockdown.

dangerAbilities.name: Dredge Line
dangerAbilities.note: Hook: stay behind minions so it cannot reach you.

dangerAbilities.name: Depth Charge
dangerAbilities.note: Targeted knockup interrupts your channel from the side.

tips.text: Stay behind minions: a hook that hits a minion pulls him, not you.
After he misses his hook, step up and Terrify him to start your own trade.
Don't channel Crowstorm when his R is ready.

powerSpikes.note: The Box makes his team's engage much stronger.
Lantern saves his carry from your ambush; kill the lantern carrier first.

dangerAbilities.name: Death Sentence
dangerAbilities.note: Pull: stay behind minions.

dangerAbilities.name: Flay
dangerAbilities.note: Knockback interrupts your channels and pushes you out of range.

tips.text: Reap him when his Q is on cooldown to stop his follow-up.
Be careful when you stand in the bush: he can still hook you out of it.
Target the lantern holder before you commit; Thresh will cancel your channel if you do not.

powerSpikes.note: Rocket Grab with Power Fist combo can kill squishies early.
Static Field pulses silence and make the ambush dangerous.

dangerAbilities.name: Rocket Grab
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range pull that wrecks your trade.

dangerAbilities.name: Static Field
dangerAbilities.note: AoE silence that stops your Terrify and Reap, so don't group up with it.

tips.text: Never step in a straight line from him; stay behind minions or in bush.
He is easy to ambush once his grab is on cooldown: Terrify then Reap.
Ward the river so he cannot grab you from fog.

powerSpikes.note: Headbutt into Pulverize is a short, strong engage.
Unbreakable Will cuts the CC he takes and makes him hard to kill in a fight.

dangerAbilities.name: Headbutt
dangerAbilities.note: Targeted knockback: don't stand next to your carry when it is ready.

dangerAbilities.name: Unbreakable Will
dangerAbilities.note: Removes CC and reduces damage, so he can walk through Terrify.

tips.text: Wait for him to use Headbutt, then trade with Terrify and Reap.
Save Crowstorm for his carry, not for him.
He is easy to out-range and poke from behind the wave.

powerSpikes.note: Death from Below executes low-health targets, and his team resets fights.
Stealth plus hook makes bush ambushes dangerous for both of you.

dangerAbilities.name: Bone Skewer
dangerAbilities.note: Pull; stay behind minions.

dangerAbilities.name: Phantom Undertow
dangerAbilities.note: Dash and stun: he can reset onto you after you commit.

dangerAbilities.name: Death from Below
dangerAbilities.note: Execute that can be dodged only by staying healthy.

tips.text: Carry a Control Ward: his stealth can turn your bush ambush around.
Don't stay low in his range: Death from Below executes low-health targets.
Terrify him first when he dashes in, so his follow-up is wasted.

itemAdjustments.name: Control Ward
itemAdjustments.note: Reveals his stealth so your ambush is safe.

powerSpikes.note: Dark Binding plus Tormented Shadow poke makes early trades hard.
Soul Shackles is an AoE lockdown.

dangerAbilities.name: Black Shield
dangerAbilities.note: Spell shield that blocks your fear and silence; bait it first.

dangerAbilities.name: Dark Binding
dangerAbilities.note: Skillshot root that interrupts your channel.

dangerAbilities.name: Soul Shackles
dangerAbilities.note: AoE chain: don't stay close to her carry in a fight.

tips.text: Wait for her to use Black Shield on a teammate, then commit your Terrify and Reap.
Stay behind minions: her root is the whole lane.
Don't start Crowstorm if her shield is up.

powerSpikes.note: Wild Growth makes her carry hard to burst.
Polymorph (Whimsy) cancels your channel and Crowstorm.

dangerAbilities.name: Whimsy
dangerAbilities.note: Targeted polymorph: interrupts your channel.

dangerAbilities.name: Help, Pix!
dangerAbilities.note: Shield she uses to save her carry from your Terrify.

tips.text: Don't start a channel when her Whimsy is up.
Target her carry, not her; she will shield and disengage.
You out-scale her lane, so you can concede the first trade.

powerSpikes.note: Monsoon heals and pushes you out of Crowstorm.

dangerAbilities.name: Howling Gale
dangerAbilities.note: Knockup that interrupts a channel.

dangerAbilities.name: Monsoon
dangerAbilities.note: Knockback that pushes you out of your fight.

tips.text: Reap her first: her whole kit needs her to cast.
Bait her Monsoon before you flash into Crowstorm.
She is easy to trade with at level 1 and 2.

powerSpikes.note: Aquatic Prison plus Ebb and Flow poke is strong in lane.
Tidal Wave is a big engage and a chase tool.

dangerAbilities.name: Aquatic Prison
dangerAbilities.note: Bubble stun interrupts your channel.

dangerAbilities.name: Tidal Wave
dangerAbilities.note: Knock-up that can catch you after your Crowstorm.

tips.text: Stay behind the wave and keep your hits to Reap / Terrify.
Wait until her bubble is on cooldown before you channel.
She is squishy: a single Terrify and Reap combo is a big threat.

powerSpikes.note: Wish heals the whole team after your Crowstorm.

dangerAbilities.name: Equinox
dangerAbilities.note: Silence and root zone that will stop your channel.

tips.text: She is immobile: Terrify then Reap is a free combo.
Bountiful Harvest on her wave heals you out of her poke.
Reap's silence cuts her heal and Equinox.

itemAdjustments.name: Chemtech Putrifier
itemAdjustments.note: Grievous Wounds if the enemy team relies on her healing.

powerSpikes.note: Light Binding plus Lucent Singularity poke is strong.
Final Spark is a long range burst.

dangerAbilities.name: Light Binding
dangerAbilities.note: Root that interrupts your channel and sets up her burst.

dangerAbilities.name: Final Spark
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range burst; don't stand low behind your carry.

tips.text: Stay behind minions to block Light Binding.
Ambush her from a bush when her Q is on cooldown.
Terrify her, then run her down before she can cast.

powerSpikes.note: Plants and Grasping Roots are a strong poke and zoning combo.
Stranglethorns is a big AoE engage.

dangerAbilities.name: Grasping Roots
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range root that interrupts your channel.

dangerAbilities.name: Stranglethorns
dangerAbilities.note: AoE knockup; don't clump in the fight.

tips.text: Kill her plants only when it's safe; otherwise ignore them.
Stay behind minions to dodge her root.
She has no escape: Terrify plus Reap wins your lane.

powerSpikes.note: Pyroclasm bounces and is a strong teamfight burst.

dangerAbilities.name: Sear
dangerAbilities.note: Stun if the target is already burning.

dangerAbilities.name: Pyroclasm
dangerAbilities.note: Bounces between squishy targets; don't group tightly.

tips.text: Stay out of Sear range and behind minions.
Brand has no escape: Terrify then Reap kills him.
Don't channel Crowstorm into a Brand who still has Sear up.

powerSpikes.note: Dawning Shadow gives a global shield and helps her carry.
Her range grows as she stacks Mist; she out-scales you if she is fed.

dangerAbilities.name: Piercing Darkness
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range poke that also heals her.

dangerAbilities.name: Last Embrace
dangerAbilities.note: Root that interrupts your channel.

tips.text: Shove the wave and Terrify her when she steps up to farm.
She is squishy: look for a Crowstorm flash-engage.
Keep your lane push controlled; she stacks Mist from minions.
